data.narrative:
Overview Energy, a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Marc Berte and Andrew Cantino, has raised $20M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader comp universe of 6 public Space & Aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX and Rocket Lab, though narrow peer comparability remains constrained.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: Stage-Progression analysis. Using the $20M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a standard Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $50M. Peer-Median comparison could not be executed—while 14 same-sector private companies exist in the dataset, fewer than 3 met narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier). Public-Comp anchoring could not be applied because Overview Energy's revenue is not on file, which is typical for private companies at this stage. The public Space & Aerospace median P/S multiple stands at 24.6x across 5 tickers, but remains unusable without revenue data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, centered on $50M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries meaningful uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a single triangulation method, absence of revenue disclosure, and insufficient private-peer data density. Material upside or downside could materialize upon revenue visibility and further stage progression.
